info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Card Financial Settlement API
info.description: The Card Financial Settlement API provides a mechanism for efficiently retrieving financial settlement details related to card transactions. Payment processors and financial institutions can leverage this API to access settlement data, which is essential for auditing and reconciliation purposes. Typical use cases include verifying transaction statuses, analyzing settlement patterns, and ensuring accurate financial reporting. This endpoint enables users to streamline their financial operations and enhance the accuracy of their accounting processes.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the financial settlement information for card transactions. It provides detailed insights into the settlement process, including amounts, dates, and relevant transaction identifiers.
